Bash(gh issue create --title "P2: Capture Ideas and Tasks" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## User Story
As a user, I want to quickly capture all my ideas, tasks, and information into a centralized "inbox" so that I can free my mind and not forget anything.

## Functional Requirements
- FR-007: Free text capture to inbox in < 3 interactions
- FR-008: Automatically timestamp each captured item
- FR-009: Real-time sync between web and iOS (< 5s delay)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. User can type text and press "Capture" to add to inbox with timestamp
2. Item captured on web appears in iOS app
3. Quick shortcut (widget/keyboard) enables capture in < 5 seconds

## Tasks
See tasks.md: P2-001 to P2-010 (10 tasks)

## Priority
P2 - First fundamental GTD step

## References
- Spec: specs/001-gtd-todo-app/spec.md (User Story 2)
- Tasks: specs/001-gtd-todo-app/tasks.md (P2 section)
EOF
)")
